name: Umiam Lake (Barapani)
description: Large artificial reservoir created by damming the Umiam River in the early 1960s, about 15-17 km north of Shillong. Popular for water sports including boating, kayaking, and scootering, with scenic views of surrounding hills and pine forests. Also known as Bara Pani.
facts: Created in early 1960s for hydroelectric power
About 15 km from Shillong on NH-40
Popular stop between Guwahati and Shillong
Orchid Lake Resort and water sports complex nearby

name: Lum Sohpetbneng (Navel of Heaven)
description: Sacred peak at about 1,343-1,344 m elevation near Umiam, revered in Khasi mythology as the site of a golden ladder or vine bridge connecting heaven and earth. Site of annual Seng Khasi pilgrimage and rituals; offers panoramic views.
facts: Name means Navel of Heaven in Khasi
About 25-40 km from Nongpoh or near Umiam
Annual festival on first or second Sunday of February
Believed origin point for Hynniewtrep clans

name: Nongkhyllem Wildlife Sanctuary
description: IUCN Category IV protected area covering 29 sq km in Ri-Bhoi, established 1981. Rich in subtropical forests, home to elephants, clouded leopards, hoolock gibbons, and over 400 bird species including hornbills. Ideal for birdwatching and nature trails.
facts: Established in 1981 from earlier reserved forest
About 60 km from Shillong near Nongpoh
Over 400 bird species recorded
Elevation range 200-950 m

name: Dwar Ksuid (Devil's Doorway)
description: Unique natural rock formation near Bhoilymbong/Umroi area, a door-like hole in a free-standing boulder on the Umiam river watershed. Offbeat scenic spot with river views, popular for short treks and photography.
facts: Name means Devil's Door in Khasi/local
About 14-17 km from Umroi Airport or near Shillong
Scenic river and forest setting
Lesser-known alternative to crowded sites

name: Umden-Diwon Eri Silk Village
description: First officially declared Eri Silk Village in Meghalaya (2021), known for ethical Ahimsa (peace) silk production called Ryndia using castor leaves without killing silkworms. Women-led weaving tradition with GI potential, attracting cultural tourists.
facts: Declared first Eri Silk Village in Feb 2021
About 70 km from Shillong
Produces Ryndia Ahimsa silk
Community-based sericulture and handloom

name: Nongpoh
description: District headquarters of Ri-Bhoi on NH-40, gateway between Guwahati and Shillong. Serves as base for Nongkhyllem Sanctuary, fruit orchards (pineapple, banana), and northern Meghalaya attractions.
facts: Headquarters of Ri-Bhoi district
About 52 km from Shillong, 48 km from Guwahati
Elevation around 485-550 m
Base for wildlife and rural tourism

name: Lum Nehru Park
description: Charming park adjacent to Orchid Lake Resort at Umiam Lake, featuring lawns, flowers, orchidarium, and aviary. Ideal for quiet picnics and nature walks amid the lake surroundings.
facts: Adjacent to Umiam Lake and Orchid Lake Resort
Features orchidarium and aviary
Quiet holiday retreat setting
Part of the Umiam tourism complex
